description: NaNbO₃ is Orthorhombic Perovskite-like structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbcm space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.88 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.67 Å. Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form corner-sharing NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 21-31°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.90-2.15 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na and two equivalent Nb atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Nb atoms to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂Nb₂ tetrahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na and two equivalent Nb atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na and two equivalent Nb atoms.
